sources.type: Full primary mechanistic, preclinical and early-clinical article
sources.read_depth: Complete main Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion and all six original figure images/legends. Supplementary Methods, Figures S1–S7, Tables S1–S4 and File S2 not obtained; raw data not reanalyzed.
Design/status, participant flow, all posted outcome rows, aggregate AE groups and selected hematologic AE rows read; no complete protocol/SAP or separate full clinical paper.

retained_positives: Reduced orthotopic intracranial tumor growth by MRI
In vitro clonogenicity suppression and apoptosis
atrt.effect_sizes_or_significance: Qualitative authors claims of significance; no survival medians, exact P values or effect sizes supplied.
atrt.independence: 2019 and 2020 abstracts share investigators, a 408-gene screen and similar MRI/survival claims. Treat as one potentially overlapping program, not independent replication; exact overlap undisclosed.
atrt.full_paper_search: No full primary ATRT PTC596 study identified in bounded web and PubMed searches. Absence from these results is not proof that none exists.
atrt.genetic_vs_drug: BMI1 shRNA/depletion, PTC596 administration and doxycycline-induced SMARCB1 re-expression are separate interventions; do not infer selective drug mechanism from genetic dependency.
atrt.normal_cerebellum: BMI1-expression comparator, not normal-cell drug-safety experiment.

mechanism.competition: Colchicine versus vinblastine competition reported in main Results; supplementary panel not read.
mechanism.response_pattern: Across 33 cancer/normal-fibroblast lines, stronger correlation with known tubulin agents and close analogs than BMI1-downregulating comparators; supportive, not proof alone.
mechanism.bmi1_status: Authors describe BMI1 reduction as secondary to tubulin-associated G2/M arrest/apoptosis and cite earlier work. Earlier cited mechanism paper not independently read here. Direct binding means PTC596 should not be treated as a validated selective BMI1-only probe.

cell_screen.normal_comparison: Normal fibroblasts included in separate 33-line mechanism-comparison panel; exact normal-line CC50 and selectivity margin in unread Table S1.

animal_studies.PTC596_doses: 5 mg/kg oral daily; 10 mg/kg oral weekly, twice weekly or every other day
animal_studies.result: Twice-weekly/every-other-day 10 mg/kg arms significantly delay time to tumor endpoint versus vehicle, P<0.001. Daily 5 mg/kg and weekly 10 mg/kg nonsignificant.
animal_studies.endpoint: Time to 1,000 mm3 or death, not unqualified lifespan
animal_studies.vehicle_composition: Not stated in accessible main Methods

comparators: temozolomide 50 mg/kg orally daily on days 10–14

animal_studies.PTC596: 12.5 mg/kg orally twice weekly for six weeks
animal_studies.combination: Docetaxel 15 mg/kg IP weekly for six weeks plus PTC596; eight tumor-free animals at day 145 among eight remaining from ten initially assigned.
animal_studies.tumor_free_denominator_limit: 8/8 in figure is TFS/study-survivors, not 100% of initially assigned animals.

animal_studies.combination: Dacarbazine 21 mg/kg IP daily for five doses plus PTC596: reported endpoint statistic 165 days at study end; five tumor-free among seven remaining from eight initial mice. Do not infer that a Kaplan–Meier median was reached.

animal_studies.tumor_free_combination: Three tumor-free animals at day 147 among three remaining from nine initially assigned.

animal_studies.result: Tumor-endpoint delays with monotherapy and selected sunitinib/paclitaxel/temozolomide combinations; does not prove all pairwise comparisons or formal synergy.

animal_quality_and_harms.randomization: Volume-balanced randomization stated for subcutaneous studies; randomized group assignment for orthotopic study.
animal_quality_and_harms.statistics: Log-rank endpoint tests; legends say correction for multiple comparisons without naming method; mean±SEM curves.
animal_quality_and_harms.censoring: Curves truncated when at least 50% reach endpoint. Removal for endpoint volume, death/moribundity or at least 20% body-weight loss.
animal_quality_and_harms.limitations: Supplementary weight data inaccessible. No comprehensive normal-cell safety or developmental/muscle safety conclusion; tumor-free survivors are not whole-cohort cure rates.

phase1_paper.population: Adults with advanced solid tumors, open label
phase1_paper.dose: 0.65–10 mg/kg orally twice weekly; eight doses per four-week cycle
phase1_paper.positive: Seven of 31 had the composite of mixed/partial response or stable disease.
phase1_paper.limit: Not objective response rate or randomized clinical benefit. Mouse-to-human exposure extrapolation is not proof of efficacy. Figure6 includes AE/SAE discontinuations; complete safety study not read.

randomized_lms_registry.source_status: Sponsor-posted ClinicalTrials.gov results, not independently read full clinical paper

regimens.active: Unesbulin 300 mg orally twice weekly plus dacarbazine 1,000 mg/m2 IV every 21 days
regimens.control: Matching placebo plus the same dacarbazine regimen

randomized_lms_registry.mITT_definition: One to three prior treatment lines
randomized_lms_registry.PFS_analysis: Independent central RECIST review; Cox regression
randomized_lms_registry.OS: Neither median estimable due to limited events; no superiority inference and no comparison statistic in inspected row.
randomized_lms_registry.AE_denominator_note: Use safety n=238/120, not mITT n=209/105. Events regardless of causality; overlapping categories not summed and raw proportions not a tested risk difference.
randomized_lms_registry.interpretation: Retain randomized incremental combination PFS benefit in stated LMS population. Do not attribute monotherapy, OS, ATRT, RMS, MVA or muscle-restoration efficacy. Trial termination alone does not negate posted benefit.
randomized_lms_registry.read_limit: No complete protocol/SAP or full independent clinical paper; abbreviated follow-up and endpoint populations must remain explicit.

supply.scope: Research listing only; no purchase or clinical-access/approval inference. Vendor BMI1 labeling is not definitive mechanism evidence and vendor trial references were not used.

bub1b.scope: No BUB1B/BUBR1 assay described in either conference abstract or full Jernigan paper.

fair_comparison: Anticancer benefit is preserved despite lack of MVA evidence. Niacin/apitegromab are also MVA-unproved. Different tumor/muscle outcomes cannot supply numerical MVA efficacy or justify replacing nominees; LMS is not case-recorded rhabdomyosarcoma.

report.scope: Bounded independent source check, not complete reread of all primary studies or clinical registry
